payload.reason: The evidence indicates that LSTM and GRU with Attention outperform all other models in offensive language identification, making them the best performing methods.

claims.text: LSTM and GRU with Attention outperform all other models in offensive language identification in terms of macro-F1, precision, and recall for both Offensive and Not Offensive classes.
Fine tuning BERT-Base Multilingual Cased model did not achieve good results for offensive language identification.
Monolingual Greek word embeddings perform significantly better than multilingual BERT embeddings for this task.
